facts.text: WINDSOR AIRLINES, Flight 114, Dulles, Christmas Eve
facts.why: Windsor Airlines Flight 114 is the plane Stuart's men crash by faking its altimeter reading. Holly is on a different plane, so the ticket puts the guest on the doomed flight.
facts.fix: ADMIT ONE, Holly's flight, Dulles, Christmas Eve

facts.why: Same problem as the ticket. Flight 114 is the Windsor plane that crashes, not Holly's.

vibe.verdict: Looks like a snowed in airport and uses the circling plane, but the food is generic airline fare and the best set pieces are missing.
missing: Marvin handing over a radio for twenty dollars (the baggage area)
McClane jamming the 747 aileron with his coat (the wing)
McClane lighting the fuel trail with a lighter (the finish)
Lorenzo tearing up the parking ticket, 'What the hell, it's Christmas!' (the ending)
The blanks in McClane's gun (the church)
ideas: Swap the 'Christmas cookies' note for 'Lorenzo tears up the ticket. What the hell, it's Christmas!'
Replace 'Dulles departure lounge buffalo wings' with 'Marvin's cart ride loaded fries'.
Change the ticket to a parking ticket stub signed by Lorenzo, replacing the Windsor boarding pass.
Swap 'Virginia ham biscuits' for a 'Fuel trail' flaming sambuca shot noting the burning fuel line that guides the planes in.
